command:
set +e
# Both TREE (muscle) results -- the engine's and the direct run's -- re-optimised under LG+G4 on their own
# topology, twice: each is a fixed point if the printed logL does not move.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p /tmp/out/eval && cd /tmp/out/eval
for t in engine direct; do
  cp /tmp/$t.treefile $t.p0.treefile
  for p in 1 2; do
    iqtree3 -s /tmp/muscle_aln.fa -m LG+G4 -te $t.p$((p-1)).treefile -T 4 -seed 12345 --prefix $t.p$p -quiet
    echo "$t pass$p $(awk -F': ' '/Log-likelihood of the tree/{print $2}' $t.p$p.iqtree | awk '{print $1}')" | tee -a eval.txt
  done
done
